paite: Ngai in, kumpipa khat diktattak in kumpipa in atu ding a, miliante'n vaihawmna diktak in vai ahawm ding uh.
heading: Chihtakna Nei Kumpipa
english: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.

paite: Huchi in mi khat huihpi lak a bukna mun bang, vuahpi lak a bitna mun, mun keu a tui luangte bang, gam tultak a suangpi lianpi nuamsatak bang ahi ding hi.
english: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.

paite: Huchi in amute mit amial kei ding a, azate bil in angaikhe ding.
english: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

paite: Mingongtatte lungtang in theihna thu atheisiam ding a, dang-awkte lei teltak in apau thei ding hi.
english: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.

paite: Migilou mithilphal achi nawnta kei ding uh, milepchiah misiam achi nawn kei ding uh.
english: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.

paite: Pathian zahlouhna thilhih ding leh TOUPA hekna dia thudiklou gen ding, gilkialte sung hawmsak ding leh dangtakte dawn ding hihmang ding in, migilou in lah gitlouhna thu agen dia, alungtang in thil ahihkhial ding hi.
english: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against Yahweh, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

paite: Milepchiah vante zaw hoih lou ahi a; tagahte'n thudik agen un leng migentheite zuauthu a hihmang ding in, ama'n lah thil gilou hih angaihtuah zel hi.
english: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.

paite: Mithilphal bel thilphal in thil liante angaihtuah a; huchi in thilphal lam thilte ah a-om gige ding hi.
english: But the noble devises noble things, and he will continue in noble things.

paite: Numei mawk omte aw, thou unla, ka aw ngaikhia un; tanu pilvangloute aw ka thugen ah bildoh un.
heading: Thukhenna Leh Tundingna
english: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!

paite: Numei pilvangloute aw, kum khat leh ni bangzah hiam nung in na buaita ding uh; grep loh ding lah a-om ngal kei ding a, grep lohkhawm ding ah leng bangmah asuak sam kei ding hi.
english: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage will fail. The harvest won’t come.

paite: Numei mawk omte aw, ling un; mipilvangloute aw, buaitak in om un; kisuah unla, vuaktang in kibawl unla, na kawng uah sai-ip puan teng un.
english: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.

paite: Lou deihte ziak leh grep guigah nuamte ziak in a-awm uh atumtum ding uhi.
english: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

paite: Ka mite gam loulingnei leh khaulingnei in nopsakna inn tengteng leh nopsakhuai khopi tengteng tung ah abuak ding hi.
english: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.

paite: Kumpipa' inn paisan a om ding ahi ngal a; amual pawng leh agalvenbuk tangtawn kohawm ding leh gam sabiltung kipahnate, ganhon tatna munte ahi ding.
english: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks,

paite: Tunglam a kipan akha ka tung ua sunbuak a a-om a, gamdai lei hoihtak mun asuah a, lei hoihtak mun lah gammang bang a sim ahih mateng.
english: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.

paite: Huai hun chiang in vaihawm diktatna gamdai ah ateng ding a, diktatna lei hoihtak mun ah a-om ding.
english: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.

paite: Huan diktatna nasep kituahna ahi ding a, diktatna a thilpawt lah tangtawn a muangtak a omna leh kitheihchetna ahi ding.
english: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.

paite: Huchi in ka mite bel galmuang a omna ah leh inkiptak leh khawlna mun muanhuaite a-omta ding uhi.
english: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places,

paite: Himahleh gammang bel hihpuk ding in gial ake ding a; khopi hihniam in a-om ding hi.
english: though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.

paite: Tui luanna piau achi theh zel, bawngtal leh sabiltung khah zelte aw, nuam na sa uhi.
english: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.
